headline: HOUWHORES 🍆💥 POUND Taiz FRONTLINE 😩🔫
text:
🚨🚨ATTENTION all you YEMEN 🇾🇪☪️ WAR SLUTS 🏜️💦 the HOUWHORES 🍆💥 are mounting 🪗 a major 🇾🇪🇾🇪🪖 OFFENSIVE 😩🔫 on Taiz 🇹🇿 the cultural 🎭 capital of civilWARfare 🏙️🍑‼️ DADDY ALI 🐐😈 stays behind 🙈 on his property 🏡 to get 🔨 POUNDED by mortars 🎯💦 while his goats BLEAT 🐐😳 and the frontLINE 🛡️ blurs in the mountains ⛰️⛰️ where Saudi 🇸🇦 backed forces 🪖 try to PUSH 🫸 BACK the advance 🛡️🍆‼️ Bodies of 1️⃣8️⃣ soldiers lie 🪦🪦 sprawled just metres 📏 from Houthi 🍆 positions so close 📍 you can 👅 almost TASTE 👄 the tension 😏🔫 while drones 🛸 BUZZ overhead 🛫 before the loud 🔊 THUDS land 🥁 one after another 🌋💥‼️ After seizing 🫳 the MokHAWT ☕ port on the RedSEA 🔴🌊 chokepoint the HouWHORES 🍆🍆 now eye 👀 the high 🏔️ ground overlooking 👀 the route 🛤️ south ready 🫡 to take 🫳 full CONTROL 😈🕳️ and leave 🚪 government troops 👮 RAILED and fractured 🦴 at 3️⃣0️⃣ checkpoints along the road from Aden 🛣️😩 Hospitals fill 🏥 with fresh 🩸 casualties from the brutal 😣 battle while 👨‍👩‍👧 families flee 🏃 barefoot into displacement 🏠 camps with nothing 🫙 but the clothes 👕 on their backs 🏕️💦 DADDY ALI 🐐😈 says he's 😱 TERRIFIED but has 🚫 no choice 🚫 or they'll 🍞 all go 🥫 hungry without the herd 🐐🍆 The UN 🇺🇳 counts 1️⃣3️⃣0️⃣0️⃣0️ newly displaced 🚶 this month 📆 as the fighting 🔥 intensifies after the four year ceasefire 🤝 got BUSTED open 🌋💥
